name: Ryoujoku Koukan Nikki [Kagai Jugyou Hen] ~Watashi, Gakkou de Sensei ni ***sarechattemasu~

source:
The violation of Ayase continues but...
the setting has moved from her teacher's basement to the outdoors.
Nothing will quench his lust... he devours her body and sullies her soul...
All the places she once lived and played peacefully... now...

对绫濑的侵犯仍在继续，但是……

没有什么能熄灭他的欲望……他吞噬她的身体，玷污她的灵魂……
所有她曾经平静地生活和玩耍的地方……现在……
